description: This file defines a Python module implementing integration with Vertex AI Agent Engine for handling LLM interactions, including configuration, request transformation, response parsing, and streaming handling. It includes classes for errors, configuration, and response streaming, with methods to prepare requests, authenticate, parse responses, and manage streaming communication with Vertex AI endpoints.

classes.name: VertexAgentEngineError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to Vertex AI Agent Engine interactions.

classes.name: VertexAgentEngineConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex AI Agent Engine interactions, including methods for URL construction, request transformation, response parsing, and streaming support.

methods.description: Prepares and validates the environment, primarily setting up authentication headers.
